# Contributors

CoreTend is written and maintained by **Ahmet Basbunar**
([@ahmetbsbnr](https://github.com/ahmetbsbnr)), who is its sole author and
the only person with commit access.

Development and finalisation were assisted by Claude, an AI assistant made by
Anthropic. Claude is a tool, not a person and not a member of a team: it holds
no account on this repository, authored no commit under its own identity, and
every change it helped produce was made under the maintainer's authorship and
responsibility.

No other individual or organisation has contributed to this project. Any
future contributor will be listed here, by their own request, with a link to
the contribution in the Git history.
